content:
My VSCode extension highlights this code strangely. 

/--
 This text is green...
   a = Σ_{k<n} b[k]
   now this is turquois?
   Putting a space after the '<' makes it so that this is also green.
-/
example : True := True.intro

In the Lean4Web, this does not happen. Is this a bug in the VSCode extension? Or some feature I'm not aware of?

This is another bug in our patched Markdown grammar (specifically the part that highlights HTML) that we use for Lean comments.

vscode-lean4#770
